content:
alex: FYI customer TykonCorp (emma) reporting 403 on text-generation endpoints even though their API key works for embeddings. Says it started after last week's billing sync. Pasting their curl and the response they get.

emma-tykon: hey team — we can still call embeddings, but when we hit /v1/text/generate we get 403. We checked key in header and it's the service account key we created last month via Okta. Here's the response: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "forbidden",
    "message": "entitlement_required",
    "details": "model:redwood-gen-3, required_plan:pro-plus"
  }
}
```

emma-tykon: repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-3","input":"hello"}'
```

lina: thanks, emma. can you paste the X-Org / account ID header and the account email you're using? also, is this the same key used for embeddings? :thinking_face:

emma-tykon: X-Org: org_8792, account: infra@tykon.com. Yes same key works for embeddings.

alex: initial hypothesis: either (A) entitlement gating for that model is on (billing/plan), or (B) token scopes are limited (e.g., only embeddings) and the SDK surface returns 403 that reads like billing. I've seen both. tagging @mike for billing flags and @colin for entitlement-service logs.

mike: looking. org_8792 on file — plan shows as "pro" but there was a legacy migration where some tenants were marked with a feature_flag set that gates new-generation models. Running a quick DB check.

colin: meanwhile I can query entitlement-service logs for that org and key. Running: 
```
SELECT * FROM entitlements WHERE org_id='org_8792' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5;
```

colin: logs show a DENY with reason: "plan_flag_missing:text_generation" at 2027-11-14T10:12:03Z. The entitlement service maps that to a 403 response with message "entitlement_required" (we should probably make this clearer).

sara: this is one of the UX pain points — 403s are ambiguous and customers assume auth. We should: (1) return an explicit error code like "plan_blocked" in addition to 403, (2) include suggested remediation string e.g., "contact billing or upgrade plan". Filing a ticket later, but for now let's get them unstuck. @mike any quick fix?

mike: we can flip the feature_flag for org_8792 to enable text_generation. There's a migration script that toggles legacy tenants. I'll do the toggle now, then ask emma to retry.

deploy-bot: [config-change] feature_flag:text_generation toggled for org_8792 by mike at 2027-11-14T10:25:12Z

emma-tykon: retrying... still 403 but response body changed slightly: now says "entitlement_required: pro-plus".

mike: hmm. that indicates their subscription tier is actually "pro" but the model requires "pro-plus". We need to confirm what their billing invoice/plan shows vs what the product catalog requires. @colin can you confirm the model's required tier?

colin: checked model metadata: redwood-gen-3 requires plan level >= "pro-plus" unless the account has an override. No override on org_8792.

emma-tykon: wait, we definitely were billed for pro-plus last month — our finance team shows the charge. Could this be a caching/migration mismatch?

alex: good catch — billing vs entitlement mismatch is common: billing service may have upgraded them but the entitlement sync job (billing->entitlements) might have failed or lagged. @mike please check the last successful sync time for org_8792.

mike: looking at sync logs: last successful sync for org_8792 was 2027-11-07. There was a sync run on 2027-11-13 that failed with downstream 502 to accounting API. That would explain stale entitlement. I'll re-run the sync for that org.

mike: re-run started. output: 
```
2027-11-14T10:34:01Z INFO starting sync for org_8792
2027-11-14T10:34:04Z INFO fetched billing: plan=pro-plus
2027-11-14T10:34:06Z INFO writing entitlement: plan=pro-plus
2027-11-14T10:34:07Z INFO sync complete
```

colin: entitlement-service shows grant now. Can you re-try the curl with same key?

emma-tykon: ok retrying... still failing. New response: 403 but body now shows "scope_missing:inference:write". Hmm. here's the response: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "forbidden",
    "message": "scope_missing",
    "details": "required_scope:inference:write"
  }
}
```

alex: aha — two issues in sequence: (1) stale entitlement, (2) token scope only had embeddings/read. The service account created via Okta likely scoped tokens to embeddings only. Emma, can you confirm how the service token was minted?

emma-tykon: we created the machine token using our internal Okta flow which requested scopes: ["inference:read","embeddings:generate"]. Looks like we missed inference:write.

sara: quick mitigation: users with billing/dev friction can be helped by creating a one-off token with broader scopes, but longer-term we should clearly document the scopes required per API surface and improve error messages to list both missing plan and missing scope. Filing an internal doc change.

mike: for this customer I can create a temporary support key with inference:write and pro-plus entitlement to unblock. emma, want me to create one and paste it here (you can rotate later)?

emma-tykon: yes please — that would unblock our release today. We will rotate/replace with properly-scoped Okta token next week.

mike: created support key sk_test_support_abc123 (expires 2027-11-21). Please use it only for validation:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_support_abc123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-3","input":"hello"}'
```

emma-tykon: works ✅ generation returned. Thanks team! We'll keep the key and rotate when we're ready.

alex: next steps (summary):
- mike: confirm billing->entitlement sync reliability and add alert if sync fails for >1h for any org that changed plan.
- sara: improve error payloads for entitlement vs scope, add suggested remediation strings and docs link.
- devex: update public docs with required scopes per API (inference:write vs inference:read vs embeddings).
- support: add quick runbook for toggling feature_flag + creating timeboxed support keys.

support-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 2027-11-21 to confirm customer rotated keys and upgrade persisted.

emma-tykon: thanks again. please keep me posted on the sync alert so we can be proactive next time.

lina: closing the thread once the billing alert and docs tasks are in flight. :thumbsup:
